notes.title: Check Out Our New Game, Party Words!
notes.content:
Greetings Programs!

[h3]Sam & Kelsie here, back at it again with another casual multiplayer party game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992530/Party_Words/]Party Words[/url]![/h3]
Party Words is a word party game with a bunch of different game modes and a ton of words to keep it fresh! Pass and play with a single device or join multiple devices to unlock new possibilities. Who's the fastest guesser? Who has all the ideas? Whose doodles are the best? Find out with Party Words.

[previewyoutube=u7tw94fGV7s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]In classic Kelsam fashion, it has a bunch of different game modes :)[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992530/Party_Words/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/595c6097c339db4d020419f40ca5f2a23a5d2ceb.png[/img][/url]

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992530/Party_Words/]Party Words[/url] is on sale for the Early Access release this week :) If you decide to check it out, please leave us a review! [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992530/Party_Words/

Let's Get This Party Started!
 - Kelsam
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Kelsam][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/3a307b3ce22f6e73f45b634cd8988e32c1fdde3b.png[/img][/url]
[h3]P.S.  It's also available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.kelsam.partywords]Google Play[/url] so your non-Steam friends can join on their devices. [/h3]
 [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.kelsam.partywords][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/5ad7fab56fd965a8b8b252ee5916326b4076acc3.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Simple Light Cycles is Now Free!
notes.content:
Greetings Programs!

In celebration of the release of our newest game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661200/Cymatically_Muffed/]Cymatically Muffed[/url], we are now offering Simple Light Cycles for free!

Thanks to everyone who has helped us get this far and supported our projects!

SLC was a game-jam style game that we put together in a weekend after playing a similar game that had laggy controls. We wanted to have a casual game to play with our friends and family that we could all enjoy and have the game be responsive enough to not cause frustration. We had a ton of fun with Simple Light Cycles and we hope you've enjoyed it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/e9fb6f225724274e151ab0a7db98ded66ab83e9b.gif[/img]


Our new game had similar goals, we wanted a game we could play together, without our 5th or 6th friends having to trade off controllers. This time around we wanted a story mode that we could play alone or together, and a PvP mode where we could fight it out with bigger groups. Muffed has a much more complex system, but we're happy to report that it's still fun for people of all ages, regardless of skill level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/59d26ad2ba2f98c10af91ee321d6fb2511c665e8.jpg[/img]


Since you're here, we're pretty sure you like local multiplayer games, we'd love it if you would [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661200/Cymatically_Muffed/]check out Muffed[/url]. :)

Thanks for playing our games!
 - Kelsam
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/a98ef0c1c2ec735495fdf1f444ea0ba02092a780.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/3a307b3ce22f6e73f45b634cd8988e32c1fdde3b.png[/img][/url]

End of Line.

notes.title: Cymatically Muffed, a new multiplayer game from Kelsam :)
notes.content:
Greetings Programs!

In case you haven't heard, we have a new multiplayer game called Cymatically Muffed :)

It's in Early Access [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661200/Cymatically_Muffed/]here on Steam[/url] if you want to check it out!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661200/Cymatically_Muffed/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/499e60673bcb6ea480090eab9597004863f8f40c.png[/img][/url]
Muffed is a fast-paced top-down shooter—⁠with weapons and game modes to spare—for 1-16 players! Co-Op campaign, machine guns, PvP battle games, laser swords, survival mode, great music, level editor, giant headphones that give you powers... is that a drone? Toss in some controllers and let's party! 


Sam and Kelsie made it, you know there's a bunch of game modes and customizations :)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661200/Cymatically_Muffed/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/35adaf60b6cc9a61a11b3e89a7f4d13ba9d2997c.png[/img][/url]

We also put in a ton of weapons
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661200/Cymatically_Muffed/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29163018/1d78861f7486900986e7e81c46ebb6603741f3b3.gif[/img][/url]

If Muffed is your speed, you should [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/661200/Cymatically_Muffed/]wishlist it[/url]! If not, we'll catch you on the grid.

Game On,
 - Kelsam

End of Line.

notes.title: v1.28 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Do not allow color change after that player has been in a game. Player can leave and re-join game to change color if needed.[/*]
	[*]Improved projectiles controls[/*]
	[*]Improved Steam Controller config[list][*]requires manual update from user via Steam Controller Configurator[/*][/list]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Assassin mode occasional points awarded on crashed bikers[/*]
	[*]Gamepads firing projectiles for keyboard players[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: v1.27 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Added "Dot Obstacles" feature (found in Gameplay Settings menu)
		[list]
			[*]When set to more than 0, this feature will render a set amount of 3x3 "dots" on the game board, in random locations, that players must avoid.[/*]
		[/list]
	[/*]
	[*]Added "Invisible Obstacles" feature (found in Gameplay Settings menu)
		[list]
			[*]When enabled, this feature will make obstacles invisible during gameplay (after the countdown).[/*]
		[/list]
	[/*]
	[*]Added feature to flash player's trail and score when they gain points (can be disabled via Gameplay Settings menu)[/*]
[/list]
